widgets_values:
One continuous 5-second 16:9 co-op console MAIN MENU shot. Eye-level / slight three-quarter — NEVER steep top-down. BOTH heroes STAND the whole time in combat IDLE — NEVER sit, NEVER walk off stage, NEVER fire weapons, NEVER muzzle flash, NEVER projectiles, NEVER bullets traveling between characters.

Location: industrial sticker game-lobby stage — black floor with yellow caution tape, spray tags, paneled wall. Premium commercial co-op lobby key art.

Readable UI glued on and MUST stay readable: upper-left cards "PLAYER 1 / LIN / READY" and "PLAYER 2 / MAX / READY"; right vertical "START NEW GAME", big glowing "CONTINUE", "SETTINGS", red-accent "EXIT GAME"; bottom "OMNI FLASH". A white mouse cursor is the hero of the shot.

Characters — tokusatsu armor, standing combat idle facing camera (equipment showcase only):
- LIN left: slim silver-cyan light armor; shoulder rail cannon stays braced on shoulder in READY IDLE — barrel does NOT spin, does NOT charge-fire; only subtle cyan LED breathe + tiny weight shift.
- MAX right: bulky amber-red heavy armor; huge dual-barrel howitzer stays cradled across arms in READY IDLE — NO shell loading motion into the breech that looks like shooting; only slow idle breathing + amber vent glow. Feet planted; NO stomp.

Camera / UI beats (menu first, weapons secondary):
1) Medium-wide full menu two-shot; cursor hovers SETTINGS then slides to CONTINUE.
2) Slow push-in as CONTINUE pulses; crisp UI click on CONTINUE (highlight expands).
3) Short punch-in on LIN card READY chime — LIN only nods 2cm, cannon idle.
4) Short punch-in on MAX card READY chime — MAX only settles stance without stomping.
5) Pull back to full two-shot; both hold idle ready pose toward lens; final punch on CONTINUE + both.

Lighting: crisp top key, cyan fill LIN, warm amber rim MAX. Audio: menu hum, UI hover ticks, CONTINUE click, dual READY chimes — NO gunshots, NO charge whine that implies firing, NO dialogue, NO pop song.
